speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: I just have a very quick supplementary question.

speaker: Ms He Ting Ru (Sengkang)
text: Just wondered, what was the assessment of the effectiveness of the POFMA legislation and, obviously, all the tools available under the POFMA regime given to the Ministries in the various authorities in order to combat these falsehoods that resulted from COVID-19-related misinformation being circulated?

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: The feedback highlighted gaps and understanding that potentially would deserve attention.

speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
text: Our actions and our concerted efforts to counter COVID-19 misinformation contributed to high levels of public trust, which have allowed us to come together as a country to achieve high vaccination coverage and implement effective COVID-19 measures.
